Name: (AAC) Auto Animation Cancel
Author: xhvsh
Description:
[size=5][b](AAC) Auto Animation Cancel[/b][/size]

Cancels tool animations the moment the hit lands, allowing faster consecutive swings with a single keybind. Built on the game's own tool logic, so targeting, facing direction and tool behaviour match vanilla.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Hit-frame cancel[/b] - the swing is cut on the tick right after the tool's hit registers, never before. No lost hits.[/*]
[*][b]Input buffering[/b] - a press made mid-swing is queued and fires immediately after the cancel.[/*]
[*][b]Target checks[/b] - the keybind only swings when the aimed tile has something the tool can affect. Empty tiles, placed objects and invalid targets are ignored.[/*]
[*][b]No ghost swings[/b] - the cancel does not trigger the game's extra follow-up animation.[/*]
[*][b]Vanilla targeting[/b] - aims at the cursor when visible, otherwise at the tile you're facing.[/*]
[*][b]Client-side[/b] - works in multiplayer without other players installing it.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Target checks[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Axe[/b] - trees, fruit trees, stumps (while falling too), destroyable bushes, twigs, weeds, giant crops, mine containers. Large stumps and hollow logs only with a strong enough axe.[/*]
[*][b]Pickaxe[/b] - stones, ore and gem nodes, weeds, mine containers, empty tilled soil. Boulders and meteorites only with a strong enough pickaxe. Machines, chests and other placed objects are never hit.[/*]
[*][b]Hoe[/b] - untilled diggable ground, artifact spots, seed spots, ginger.[/*]
[*][b]Watering can[/b] - dry tilled soil, dry garden pots, empty pet bowls, refilling at water when not full.[/*]
[/list]Anything else still works with the normal tool button.

[size=4][b]Notes[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]The keybind always performs an uncharged swing. Charging upgraded tools stays on the normal tool button.[/*]
[*]Melee weapons: the keybind acts as a regular attack click.[/*]
[*]Scythe, fishing rod, slingshot and other tools are not affected.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
Editable in [i]config.json[/i] or in-game via Generic Mod Config Menu.
[list]
[*][b]CancelKey[/b] - keybind (default: Space)[/*]
[*][b]GuardMisclicks[/b] - enable target checks (default: true)[/*]
[*][b]BufferInput[/b] - queue presses made mid-swing (default: true)[/*]
[*][b]PostHitDelayMs[/b] - extra delay before cancelling, in ms (default: 0)[/*]
[*][b]EnableAxe / EnablePickaxe / EnableHoe / EnableWateringCan / EnableMeleeWeapons[/b] - per-tool toggles[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.0+[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (optional)[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Extract the zip into [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i].[/*]
[*]Run the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
Do not use alongside other animation cancel mods.
